title.en: Stitches is Currently Neutral, but will Terrorize Duskwood Again Soon in WoW: Forever
title.es: Stitches es actualmente neutral, pero volverá a aterrorizar a Duskwood pronto en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Stitches is Currently Neutral, but will Terrorize Duskwood Again Soon in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Stitches es actualmente neutral, pero volverá a aterrorizar a Duskwood pronto en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Stitches is notorious for killing unsuspecting players in Duskwood, but right now, he's a little calmer than normal - Blizzard has confirmed that this is a bug and will be fixed.

One of the most infamous NPC's in the Eastern Kingdoms, there's no mob quite like Stitches when it comes to striking fear into players' hearts (unless you're talking about Hogger). Since the latest WoW: Forever beta build, though, Stitches has been noticeably... nicer. Instead of being a hostile elite patrolling the zone, Stitches has been spotted in a neutral state, meaning he won't kill unsuspecting passersby like usual. Players have already taken to social media regarding the change, and thankfully, an answer has already been given: Principal Game Designer Johnny Cash has confirmed that Stitches shouldn't be neutral, and the bug is working on being fixed.

Tweet #2106031126322274580


The terror of Duskwood will be back again soon - until then, players will have to wait for Stitches to return to his old fearsome self!

title.en: Skinning No Longer Group-Wide in Latest WoW: Forever Beta Build
title.es: Skinning ya no es para todo el grupo en el último WoW: Forever Beta Build

summary.en: Skinning No Longer Group-Wide in Latest WoW: Forever Beta Build...
summary.es: Skinning ya no es para todo el grupo en el último WoW: Forever Beta Build...

contentHtml:
In the latest WoW: Forever build, creatures can only be skinned once before they disappear.

The skinning profession allows players to skin certain types of creatures for leather. In WoW: Classic, once a mob was skinned once, the corpse would despawn. However, for the last two weeks of WoW: Forever, mobs were able to be skinned multiple times if players were grouped (once per group member), which increased the amount of leather that could be obtained from a single mob. For players, it was unclear if this was intended or a bug.
  • Skinning
    • Creatures can once again only be skinned a single time before disappearing.
In the latest WoW: Forever build, Blizzard has made it clear that this was a bug and the functionality has returned to one skinner per mob. This will change the leather economy when WoW: Forever launches on live servers on November 4th.

title.es: [Actualizado] Líquido y eco discutiendo menos personajes y divisiones para la próxima carrera al primer mundo

summary.en: [Updated] Liquid and Echo Discussing Less Characters and Splits for Next Race to World First...
summary.es: [Actualizado] Líquido y eco discutiendo menos personajes y divisiones para la próxima carrera al primer mundo...

contentHtml:
Liquid Max has revealed that Liquid and Echo are currently in talks about doing fewer characters and splits for the Race to World First!

Update (9:21 AM PT) Meeres from Echo has reached out and said the times mentioned in the video weren't directly asked for by Echo. He also mentioned that they are in further talks at this time, as Liquid declined this original deal.


One of the major criticisms of recent Race to World Firsts has been splits. In this tier, it took Liquid five and a half days before they entered Mythic Venomous Abyss, and we have even seen Mythic splits in the last few tiers. The Race to World First guilds have around 15 characters and run many, many splits to make sure they have all the gear that they need, which is not interesting to watch, or fun for some of the players themselves.

In a recent stream and highlighted in a video, Liquid Max talks about some of these discussions.



Max comments that they have discussed helper splits, raiders in the guild, AFK Mythic+, and Mythic splits, and implies both guilds are willing to do that. However, there are some things regarding raiding time that they are not in agreement on at this time.

Further talks are apparently in progress, and we'll have to see what changes the next Race to World First has in store.

summary.en: Book Collection Ring No Longer Class Restricted in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: El anillo de colección de libros ya no está restringido en WoW: para siempre...

contentHtml:
Throughout the world in World of Warcraft: Forever, players can collect various books that allow them to unlock new quests. At 20 books, you unlock the quest Greater Friend of the Library, which grants the player one of two rings, including Field Researcher's Loop. This item was previously a Rogue-only ring, but it has since been changed and is now available to all classes.



Wowhead User Patrickjarvis324 completed this as an Alliance player and detailed the recommended books to acquire 20. Now that players can reach level 30, some of these will likely be much easier to obtain.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted warrior updates for today's WoW: Forever beta build!
Blizzard
View Original
A number of additional updates for Warriors in WoW Forever made it into today’s new Beta build, and we just added all of the following to our Development Notes for today.

Warrior
  • Additional Rage generated from landing Critical Strikes increased to 100% increased Rage (was 75%).
  • Fixed a bug that was causing Dual Wield Specialization to grant its increase to Hit Chance to both weapons.
  • Developers’ notes: Because of the above bug, our tests needed some correcting, so we did another pass on Fury Warrior.
  • Fury
    • Developers’ notes: Our goal here is to give Fury more access to utility and meaningful choices early in the tree for leveling, and free up points later for more choices instead of being stuck placing points into Enrage to get Flurry.
    • Booming Voice is now a 10/20/30/40/50% increase area of effect to your Shouts and a 5/10/15/20/25% reduction to their Rage costs.
    • Unbridled Wrath no longer grants twice as much Rage to two-handed weapons.
    • New Talent Lingering Rage in Row 2 of Fury. Lingering Rage increases the time before your Rage begins to decay when leaving combat by 2/4/6/8/10 seconds.
    • Blood Craze no longer activates off of Bloodthirst casts.
    • The Improved Cleave talent has been removed.
    • The Boundless Rage talent has been removed.
    • New Talent Furious Precision in Row 3 of Fury. Furious Precision increases your chance to hit with off-hand attacks by 4/7/10%.
    • Raging Blows now reduces the Rage cost of your Cleave and Whirlwind abilities by 3.
    • Raging Blows no longer causes your Whirlwind to strike with your offhand. Whirlwind will now always strike with both weapons without requiring a talent point.
    • Dual Wield Specialization no longer grants hit to your off-hand attacks.
    • Enrage is no longer required to reach the Flurry talent.
    • Death Wish is now required to reach the Flurry talent.
    • New Talent Gore Drinker in Row 6 of Fury, requires the Enrage talent. Your Enrage, Berserker Rage, Bloodrage, Death Wish, and Bloodthirst abilities cause your next 3 melee attacks to restore 0.5/1% of your maximum Health.
    • Improved Berserker Rage moved to Row 5 of Fury (Was Row 6).
    • Berserker Rage is now available at level 30 (Was 32)
    • Bloodthirst’s Attack Power ratio has been increased to 45% (Was 35%).
  • Protection
    • Developers’ notes: Our goal is to give non-shield users a clear path to the middle of the tree, where Protection could serve as a PvP tech secondary specialization, with more access to Improved Bloodrage, Iron Will, Improved Disarm, Last Stand, and Improved Shield Bash.
    • Iron Will moved to the Row 1 of Protection (Was Row 2 of Fury).
    • Anticipation moved to Row 2 (Was Row 1).
    • Toughness has been removed.
    • Improved Bloodrage moved to Row 1 (Was Row 2).
    • Improved Revenge moved to Row 2 (Was Row 3).
    • Improved Disarm moved to Row 3 (Was Row 4).
    • Improved Shield Bash moved to Row 4 (Was Row 5).

contentHtml:
In the latest build of the WoW Forever Beta, the Gnome racial ability Eureka! has received yet another nerf, this time now not working at all on periodic effects. The first nerf to Eureka was a flat percent reduction of its discount effect on resources.
View Original
Races
  • Gnome
    • Eureka! no longer benefits periodic effects at all. Channeled spells do not count as periodics.
This affects each eligible class slightly differently, and you can see the spell adjustments below.

Racial Traits (4)

    • REMOVED Effect #3 Apply Aura: Modifies Periodic Damage/Healing Done
      Value: 10%
      Affected Spells:
      Garrote Rupture Garrote
      Garrote Garrote Rupture
      Rupture Rupture Rupture
      Rupture Garrote Garrote
      Rupture Rupture Rupture
      Garrote Garrote Garrote
      Garrote Garrote Garrote
      Rupture
    • Effect #3 Apply Aura: Dummy: Modifies Damage/Healing Done
      Value: 110
    • NEW Effect #4 Apply Aura: Dummy: Modifies Damage/Healing Done

  • Eureka!  Your next 3 non-periodic damaging abilities have their Rage cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage.
